name: Fidel-TS
description: A high-fidelity multimodal benchmark for time series forecasting designed with principles of data sourcing integrity, leak-free and causally sound design, and structural clarity to address flaws in existing datasets.
reputation: A very recent forecasting benchmark that emphasizes leak-free, causally sound design, but it is not yet broadly established in the community.
notes: Built from live APIs to avoid data contamination and leakage issues in prior benchmarks.
